questions.prompt: Is the PowerShell equality comparison operator `-eq` case-sensitive by default?

options.a: No — it is case-insensitive by default (-ceq is the case-sensitive variant)
options.b: Yes — strings must match exact casing
options.c: It depends on whether $Option:CaseSensitive is set

questions.prompt: Does a PowerShell `switch` statement stop processing automatically after the first matching condition?

options.a: No — it falls through to subsequent conditions unless explicitly stopped with break or continue
options.b: Yes — it acts like C/Java switch statements and breaks implicitly
options.c: Yes — unless the -FallThrough flag is passed

questions.prompt: What parameter must be added to a cmdlet call (like `Get-Content`) to make non-terminating errors catchable by `try/catch`?
What does adding the `[CmdletBinding()]` attribute to a function definition do?

options.a: Promotes it to an advanced function, granting common parameters (-Verbose, -ErrorAction) and $PSCmdlet
options.b: Compiles the function into a C# DLL
